data.title: Elora The Valley
data.about:
The Valley is a lovely new neighborhood comprised of contemporary 3 and 4 Bedroom townhouse complexes inspired by the vast shimmering sands and lush green open areas. 

It is a self-sufficient community that offers a wide range of lifestyle amenities, educational possibilities, healthcare services, leisure activities, and recreational facilities in a picturesque setting. Sustainable constructions that are completely integrated with the natural surroundings and surrounded by the amazing beauty of the green ground may be found. Elora is a an enchanting neighbourhood hidden away from the chaos of the city, yet nearby major landmarks in Dubai.

location_tile.title: Perfectly Positioned With Easy Access To All Major Areas of Dubai
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The Valley is well located on the Dubai-Al Ain Road, a direct roadway that serves as a vital link between the emirates of Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Elora is a neighborhood with convenient access to all major areas of Dubai as well as a variety of green open spaces.

05 Mins from Rugby Sevens
08 Mins from Dubai Outlet Mall
25 Mins from Burj Khalifa
25 Mins from Dubai International Airport
